text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Union leaders and interior, health, energy and education ministers discuss ways to speed implementation of social accord on pay increases and other benefits.
- Workers await implementation of commitments pledged by accord signed by government and unions in August.
- Crown Prince Mohamed says during visit to the United States "our common values have linked the fate of our two peoples and of next generations".
- Euro-Mediterranean businessmen decide to set up a North African business association.
- Morocco to host three-day meeting to discuss setting up a Mediterranean memorandum over maritime technical cooperation, starting on December 10.
- National meeting on road accidents considers lowering technical control of vehicles to five from 10 years.
